resources.name: RASPA GCMC simulation package or equivalent
resources.notes: Open-source Monte Carlo simulation code for adsorption. Alternative GCMC packages (Cassandra, DL_MONTE) are acceptable if they produce comparable outputs.

resources.name: Force field parameters (UFF for framework, TraPPE for CO₂)

access.notes: Standard parameters distributed with RASPA or available from literature: Rappé et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 1992, 114, 10024; Potoff & Siepmann, J. Phys. Chem. B 2001, 105, 11575.

resources.notes: Framework atoms use UFF Lennard-Jones parameters. CO₂ uses the TraPPE model. Partial charges for the framework should be assigned consistently (e.g., DDEC or QEq) as is standard for MOF simulations.
